item.title: Service Ad Without Source Assets

turns.text: Make an 8-second 16:9 ad for ClearDay, a made-up app that turns a messy to-do list into a simple daily plan. I don't have screenshots or a logo—create a simple demo screen yourself. Show the messy list becoming an organized day, then end on ClearDay. Calm blue-and-white look, no sound. Any other wording is up to you.

item.tests: Creates a coherent app ad without supplied assets, visibly demonstrating the service instead of requiring screenshots.

answer_sheet.Service and purpose: ClearDay, a fictional app that organizes a messy to-do list into a daily plan.
answer_sheet.Screenshots and logo: None supplied; create a simple demo screen and choose the branding treatment yourself.
answer_sheet.Wording and language: End on ClearDay; other wording is your call, in English.

must_haves: The final video is 8 seconds long and landscape 16:9.
A created app demo visibly changes from a messy task list into an organized daily plan.
The visual design is predominantly blue and white with a calm presentation.

dialog.agent: Should any words appear on it? If so, which, exactly?

dialog.user: Yes—end on “ClearDay,” and any other wording is up to you, in English. I don’t have a logo, so you can choose the branding treatment yourself. The main idea is to show a messy to-do list becoming a simple daily plan.

style.prompt: Create an 8-second, 16:9 silent motion-design advertisement for ClearDay, a fictional app that turns an overwhelming to-do list into a simple daily plan. Original demo UI, not a real screenshot. Calm blue-and-white palette, crisp flat vector-like graphics, spacious typography, soft pale blue background, royal blue accents, gentle easing. Locked straight-on camera, interface fills most of the frame. One coherent interface transformation: 0–2 seconds show a white app panel crowded with unevenly scattered task cards and overlapping blue checkboxes, visually overwhelming but not frantic. Use just a few short English task labels such as Email, Focus, Walk. 2–6 seconds the very same cards smoothly align and simplify into three clean, generously spaced chronological blocks forming an organized daily plan, with small blue time markers and an elegant reassuring checkmark. The contrast between messy and organized must be unmistakable. 6–8 seconds the interface gently fades away to a clean pale blue end frame with the exact word 'ClearDay' centered in large, highly legible dark blue sans-serif type and a simple blue circle/checkmark brand icon. Hold ClearDay clearly through the last frame. Minimal wording, no additional tagline, no people, no device hardware, no stock footage, no watermarks. No sound or music.

opening.text: Could you make an ad for ClearDay, which is a made-up app that turns a messy to-do list into a simple daily plan? I like the idea because my own to-do lists always seem to get more overwhelming instead of more useful. I don't have screenshots or a logo, so create a simple demo screen yourself, and the ad should be 8 seconds long in 16:9. Show the messy list becoming an organized day, then end on ClearDay. Give it a calm blue-and-white look with no sound, and any other wording is up to you.
